about_the_game:
Ride into the spirited world of Cheyenne, a lively cowgirl whose straightforward charm is matched by her teasing personality. This DLC enriches Model Casting with Cheyenne’s engaging storyline, playful dialogues, and explicit intimate moments. Engage her with witty banter and sassy exchanges, discovering the fiery passion behind her playful attitude. Each encounter with Cheyenne promises fun, flirtation, and memorable explicit scenes that capture her irresistible western charm.

Key Features:

  • Exclusive Character: Cheyenne, a sassy and playful cowgirl.

  • Three Exciting Chapters: The Interview, Lewd Meeting, and Lewd Visit (Sandbox).

  • Customized H-scenes: Explicit scenes that highlight Cheyenne’s teasing and flirty personality.

  • Playful & Sassy Dialogue: Interactive conversations loaded with playful charm.

  • High Replayability: Diverse dialogue choices providing varied explicit scenarios.

content_descriptors.notes:
Model Casting is an adult visual novel designed for mature audiences and features explicit sexual content, nudity, and strong language. Players interact with fictional characters in scenarios that include suggestive photoshoots, intimate dialogues, and consensual sexual encounters. All characters depicted in the game are 18 years or older.

The mature content is presented as part of the storyline and character development, focusing on consensual relationships and mutual respect. The game does not include depictions of sexual assault, non-consensual acts, extreme violence, self-harm, or drug/alcohol abuse. Instead, it aims to provide an immersive, character-driven experience that explores adult themes in a thoughtful and engaging manner.
